title: Fleet Wrangler: interactive scaling playground, throughput insights, and change trace
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an integrated Console surface ("Fleet Wrangler") that lets operators: 1) interactively tune per-fleet scaling knobs (min/max capacity, target p95 latency, burst buffer), 2) preview and simulate autoscaling policy effects against historical traffic, and 3) view an immutable change trace (who changed what, playback of scaling decisions, and automatic rollback suggestions). The goal is to provide confidence for SREs and platform owners running Redwood Dedicated fleets to meet throughput guarantees while minimizing cost and risk.
acceptance_criteria: Scaling playground: UI allows changing min/max GPU count, target latency, and burst window and shows realtime simulated throughput & cost delta
Autoscale composer: users can create/save named policies with step/target-based rules and attach to a fleet
Simulation engine: runs policies against 30/90 day workload snapshots and returns expected scaling events and estimated token cost savings
Throughput dashboard: per-fleet p50/p95/p99 latency, steady-state throughput, and per-route token breakdown available for last 7/30/90 days
Change trace: chronological immutable log with user, diff, reason, linked PR/Confluence, and 1-click rewind to previous policy under feature flag
Audit + Compliance: exportable CSV of change history and optional retention window configured by org
End-to-end flow covered by e2e tests and manual QA checklist; feature gated behind console feature flag and gradual rollout plan
